title: ERG representative trace grid
background: Floating small-multiples of raw ERG waveforms, laid out the way retinal-electrophysiology figures are published — flash-intensity series down the rows, conditions across the columns, one shared scale bar. Decodes raw iWorx LabScribe (.iwxdata) and Diagnosys Espion exports natively; amplitude and timing conventions follow the ISCEV full-field ERG Standard.

references.title: ISCEV Standard for full-field clinical electroretinography (2022 update)
references.authors: Robson AG, Frishman LJ, Grigg J, et al.
references.note: Defines the a-/b-wave amplitude and implicit-time conventions this skill follows.

references.title: iWorx LabScribe (.iwxdata ERG acquisition)
references.note: Native input format — decoded by a clean-room pure-stdlib reader (skills/_iwx.py).

references.title: Diagnosys Espion / Celeris (ERG export)
references.note: Native input format — decoded by a clean-room pure-stdlib reader (skills/_celeris.py).

catalog.summary: Stacked floating ERG waveforms — flash-intensity series down the rows, conditions across the columns, no per-panel axes, one shared scale bar. The publication layout GraphPad/Excel can't make. Ingests raw iWorx .iwxdata, LabScribe .txt, or a long waveform table; 'clean flats, keep OPs' filtering; attaches an a/b-wave table.
